findings.title: Success-only caller ownership
findings.cause: Raw origin/proxy handles span fallible setup, request work and assertions. Early error, cancellation or outer timeout drops handles; success-only joins lose completed secondary outcomes. h2_origin also breaks on any final accept error.
findings.affected_calls: All spawned one-shot tests and assert_h2_forwarding. Keep actual clients through cleanup where driver progress needs them.
findings.proposed_remedy: Eager existing ConnectionPeer adoption and explicit finite primary plus cleanup observation; preserve both typed outcomes and avoid repolling completed tasks.
findings.independent_contract: Actual H2 forwarding/CONNECT request, literal response and body before cancellation; external peer/runtime retained. Completed typed peer error after traffic plus primary caller failure must survive same completion seam.

findings.title: Driver, relay and listener trees lack an owner
findings.cause: Forward records return after detached connection driver spawn. Tunnel records return after detached accept driving; bidirectional relays drop both handles. Multiplex spawn_limited_proxy and spawn_origin detach listeners and accepted/relay children, returning no shutdown owner. WebSocket multiplex also holds a raw echo handle across fallible setup.
findings.affected_calls: All forwarded/tunnel fixture consumers; every async multiplex test via repeated proxy/origin workers.
findings.proposed_remedy: Concrete local fixture owner for actual handoff; cover listener, connections and relay descendants with finite shutdown/drain. A front abort handle alone is incomplete.
findings.independent_contract: Actual verified H2 CONNECT and nonzero upstream bytes before owner cancellation; capture descendant destruction/address release before backup cleanup with external client/origin/runtime alive. No permanent leak inferred.

findings.title: Unexpected fixture failures become ordinary termination
findings.cause: Accept loops ignore any error. has_ended maps any body error to false, potentially satisfying Firefox not-ended assertion. Relay DATA errors, flow release, write shutdown, EOF versus read error, capacity/send errors and final send are discarded. Multiplex children discard typed failures; origin swallows TLS/read/write errors, proxy TLS error is stringified.
findings.proposed_remedy: Propagate concrete results and context; retain unexpected protocol/I/O/flow causes, classify only independently established deliberate disconnects. Expose has_ended observed body error rather than false.
findings.independent_contract: Actual post-exchange INTERNAL_ERROR or controlled PermissionDenied via actual seam; exact typed cause required. Positive actual CANCEL/EOF and legitimate disconnect whitelist retained. Initial body assertions catch many failures, but late failures remain unobserved.

findings.title: Deadlines lose Elapsed
findings.cause: Both owner bounded helpers map Tokio Elapsed into a string; multiplex 451-458 has same cause loss.
findings.affected_calls: All bounded methods in both owners.
findings.proposed_remedy: Same ten-second timer and literal operation context, with concrete Elapsed as source; inner error and ready result unchanged.
findings.independent_contract: Paused-clock actual pending poll then advance; require Elapsed through source chain and context. Pair typed inner-error and ready-operation positives.

findings.title: Poisoned observers become missing observations
findings.cause: Log poisoning skips Seen insertion and seen returns empty Vec. Recording.poll_read in proxy_h2 silently skips poisoned wire capture. Exact nonempty placement assertions still fail, but observer cause is erased.
findings.affected_calls: All multiplex placement tests and recorded forwarding/HPACK consumers.
findings.proposed_remedy: Return explicit observer poison/context failure instead of empty or skipped successful observation; retain exact existing placements and wire oracles.
findings.independent_contract: Join an intentional poisoning thread, then exercise actual recording/read seam after a nonzero real exchange; require poison cause. Healthy recording positive remains.

findings.title: Deliberate CONNECT 502 result is discarded
findings.cause: Three tests intentionally reply Status 502 but discard HTTPS/WSS result, accepting arbitrary failure or unexpected success once fields are recorded.
findings.proposed_remedy: Assert actual Proxy and HttpConnectError::Rejected{status:502}, including source, while preserving fields, stream IDs, END_STREAM and user-agent assertions.
findings.independent_contract: Actual rejection fixture gives real request barrier. Pair unexpected typed failure/success negative with deliberately rejected502 positive; retain completed peer cause on caller failure. No origin TLS success expected after 502.

findings.title: Remembered HPACK dynamic-table claim is underconstrained
findings.cause: Remembered block only rejects NeverIndexed and name index 49. LiteralWithoutIndexing with literal name index 0 and identical proxy-authorization value passes; decoded semantic credential checks and replay IncrementalIndexing 49 remain strong.
findings.proposed_remedy: Bind remembered authorization to the actual indexed dynamic entry with table context or precise supported byte representation. Requiring merely any indexed field is insufficient.
findings.independent_contract: Actual helper counterexample: challenged empty; replay literal-with-indexing static name49 plus value; remembered literal-without-indexing name0 plus proxy-authorization name/value. Pinned decoder explicitly accepts this valid form without indexing; same decoded credential cannot prove dynamic-table use. Real dynamic indexed positive needs actual preceding table state.

findings.title: Malformed decoder inputs can panic or appear complete
findings.cause: Hex slices lack even-length/UTF8 boundary checks. Short priority payload uses payload[5..]. Trailing incomplete frame head is silently accepted. HPACK integer shift/add lacks bounds; string cursor arithmetic is unchecked and pseudo_names may jump past truncated value then return names.
findings.affected_calls: captured_h2_blocks and all capture consumers; header_blocks, first_pseudo_order and HPACK form helpers.
findings.proposed_remedy: Checked slices/arithmetic and explicit truncated/overflow errors in actual supported parser scope; preserve limited unpadded single-frame HEADERS contract. Reuse resolved decoder if public interface permits.
findings.independent_contract: Actual helper odd/non-ASCII hex, priority HEADERS length0 flags24, preface plus partial next header, oversized integer and truncated pseudo string negatives; valid literals/captured blocks positive. Tracked/client-generated test input only, no production hostile-traffic claim.

findings.title: Imports and operation paragraphs need grouping
findings.cause: Local imports precede standard/external groups in both owners; independent lookup/decode/guard/response/cleanup phases are dense. Ownership handoffs need clear paragraphs.
findings.affected_calls: Both whole owners, especially parser/serve functions and multiplex request phases.
findings.proposed_remedy: Bounded import/paragraph cleanup with lifecycle remedy. Extract only a distinct responsibility with real callers; no line-count crate split or generic all-protocol framework.
findings.independent_contract: No whitespace behavior test. Preserve literal/assertion tokens and exact nonblank bytes for pure grouping portions.

rejected_or_qualified_candidates: Empty multiplex placement is not a successful oracle: exact nonempty 2/3-entry equality precedes all(CONNECT). Poison still loses explicit cause.
Second-listener absence checks use outer timeout.is_err: actual accept I/O error is Ok(Err) and makes absence false. Scope is finite 100ms only.
Wrong-ALPN controls retain typed UnsupportedAlpn and deliberate is_peer_gone whitelist: reset/aborted/broken-pipe/UnexpectedEof. Arbitrary I/O and quiet timeout make assertion false.
Classic CONNECT scheme/path absence is enforced by the pinned server for CONNECT without Protocol; not general raw field order/HPACK parity.
Status 502 intentionally rejects tunnel; no client routing or TLS defect follows.
poll_capacity assigned capacity is documented always positive. No zero-capacity spin inferred; SomeErr/None swallowing remains supported.
Raw task code does not establish permanent OS leak; local runtime shutdown eventually tears down tasks. Need external runtime/client retained through causal cancellation observations.
Initial client status/body assertions detect many relay failures. Late failures after valid exchange or caller cancellation are not necessarily detected.
Test credentials alice/secret are known synthetic values; no actual captured secret leak identified.

WebSocket echo_h1 itself requires second client opcode 8 and literal echo, so dropping its returned record does not erase those checks. Outer test lacks explicit server Close-kind assertion. Supporting final read_to_end discards arbitrary error: separately qualified outside owned repair scope.
Comments mentioning every capture run do not receive parity credit: current fixture reader selects run 0. Independent capture evidence is outside this bounded source pass.
